name: Arrowhead
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode for a challenge: arrow gems cross the board, one gem the way they point after every move. An arrow that leaves by the top ends the game; one that leaves by any other edge is a shot and scores a bonus that grows with each arrow cleared, as does matching an arrow. The only move is a twist: click where four gems meet to turn them clockwise, or right click to turn them the other way, and a twist turns the arrows it holds a quarter turn with it, so you can steer an arrow away from the top. When gems below an arrow clear, it falls with the rest. Eight kinds of gem. A new arrow starts at the edge behind it every 8 moves, one move sooner each level, down to 5. Uses its own high-score table. Turn on one game mode at a time.
